name: Sesotho
orthography: South African standard orthography (kg, tj, y, w, di/du); Lesotho spelling (kh for kg, tš, ch, e/o for y/w) is not supported
notes: Broad phonemic transcription built from orthography2ipa st.json and the Wikipedia articles on Sesotho phonology and orthography.
Plain p t k ts tl tj pj are ejective; the ejective mark is left out because the spelling predicts it, and the aspirated series carries ʰ.

Sesotho has nine vowels written with five letters. e and o are written ɪ ʊ, their value in the frequent prefixes (ho, mo, le, se, bo); ê ô, where a text marks them, are ɛ ɔ. The vowel harmony that chooses between them is left for the voice to learn.
kg is the velar fricative x (the affricate kxʰ is an older variant); j is the fricative ʒ (dʒ is a variant); r is uvular, written ʁ.
Tone is not written and is not transcribed.

rules.note: Velar nasal before k, ng and clicks: ho nka [hʊŋkʼa], ho senngwa [hʊsɪŋŋwa], nq [ŋǃ]. ng is its own letter (ŋ).
Palatal nasal before palatals: ntja [ɲtʃʼa], nnyeo [ɲɲeo].
